column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT clients.totalActiveClients, loans.totalLoans, loans.activeLoans, loans.pendingApprovalLoans, loans.closedLoans, savings.totalSavingsAccounts, savings.activeSavings, demand.AmountDue, demand.AmountPaid, disbursal.amountToBeDisburse, disbursal.disbursedAmount, clienttrend.clientTrendData, loantrend.loanTrendData, offices.officeData, loanproducts.loanProductData, clientbyoffice.clientByOfficeData FROM (SELECT COUNT(c.id) AS totalActiveClients FROM m_client c JOIN m_office o ON o.id = c.office_id WHERE c.status_enum = 300 AND o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ino.hierarchy FROM m_office ino WHERE ino.id = ${officeId}), '%') ) clients, (SELECT COUNT(l.id) AS totalLoans, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.loan_status_id = 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activeLoans, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.loan_status_id = 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingApprovalLoans, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.loan_status_id = 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closedLoans FROM m_loan l JOIN m_client cl ON cl.id = l.client_id JOIN m_office o ON o.id = cl.office_id WHERE o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ino.hierarchy FROM m_office ino WHERE ino.id = ${officeId}), '%') ) loans, (SELECT COUNT(sa.id) AS totalSavingsAccounts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sa.status_enum = 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activeSavings FROM m_savings_account sa JOIN m_client cl ON cl.id = sa.client_id JOIN m_office o ON o.id = cl.office_id WHERE o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ino.hierarchy FROM m_office ino WHERE ino.id = ${officeId}), '%') ) savings, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ls.principal_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.principal_writtenoff_derived), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(ls.interest_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.interest_writtenoff_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.interest_waived_derived), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(ls.fee_charges_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.fee_charges_writtenoff_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.fee_charges_waived_derived), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_writtenoff_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_waived_derived), 0) - (COALESCE(SUM(ls.principal_completed_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.principal_writtenoff_derived), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(ls.interest_completed_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.interest_writtenoff_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.interest_waived_derived), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(ls.fee_charges_completed_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.fee_charges_writtenoff_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.fee_charges_waived_derived), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_completed_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_writtenoff_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_waived_derived), 0)) AS AmountDue, COALESCE(SUM(ls.principal_completed_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.principal_writtenoff_derived), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(ls.interest_completed_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.interest_writtenoff_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.interest_waived_derived), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(ls.fee_charges_completed_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.fee_charges_writtenoff_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.fee_charges_waived_derived), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_completed_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_writtenoff_derived), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_waived_derived), 0) AS AmountPaid FROM m_office o LEFT JOIN m_client cl ON o.id = cl.office_id LEFT JOIN m_loan ln ON cl.id = ln.client_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule ls ON ln.id = ls.loan_id WHERE o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ino.hierarchy FROM m_office ino WHERE ino.id = ${officeId}), '%') ) demand, (SELECT COALESCE(awaitind.amount, 0) - COALESCE(disbursed.amount, 0) AS amountToBeDisburse, COALESCE(disbursed.amount, 0) AS disbursedAmount FROM (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ln.principal_amount), 0) AS amount FROM m_office o LEFT JOIN m_client cl ON cl.office_id = o.id LEFT JOIN m_loan ln ON cl.id = ln.client_id WHERE (ln.loan_status_id = 200 OR ln.loan_status_id = 300) AND o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ino.hierarchy FROM m_office ino WHERE ino.id = ${officeId}), '%') ) awaitind, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ltrxn.amount), 0) AS amount FROM m_office o LEFT JOIN m_client cl ON cl.office_id = o.id LEFT JOIN m_loan ln ON cl.id = ln.client_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_transaction ltrxn ON ln.id = ltrxn.loan_id WHERE ltrxn.is_reversed = false AND ltrxn.transaction_type_enum = 1 AND o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ino.hierarchy FROM m_office ino WHERE ino.id = ${officeId}), '%') ) disbursed ) disbursal, (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(STRING_AGG(CONCAT(cnt, ':', mnth), ','), '') AS VARCHAR(2000)) AS clientTrendData FROM ( SELECT COUNT(cl.id) AS cnt, TRIM(TO_CHAR(cl.activation_date, 'Month')) AS mnth FROM m_office o LEFT JOIN m_client cl ON o.id = cl.office_id WHERE o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ino.hierarchy FROM m_office ino WHERE ino.id = ${officeId}), '%') AND cl.activation_date BETWEEN (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months') AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY TRIM(TO_CHAR(cl.activation_date, 'Month')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cl.activation_date) ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM cl.activation_date) ASC ) ct ) clienttrend, (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(STRING_AGG(CONCAT(cnt, ':', mnth), ','), '') AS VARCHAR(2000)) AS loanTrendData FROM ( SELECT COUNT(ln.id) AS cnt, TRIM(TO_CHAR(ln.disbursedon_date, 'Month')) AS mnth FROM m_office o LEFT JOIN m_client cl ON o.id = cl.office_id LEFT JOIN m_loan ln ON cl.id = ln.client_id WHERE o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ino.hierarchy FROM m_office ino WHERE ino.id = ${officeId}), '%') AND ln.disbursedon_date BETWEEN (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months') AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY TRIM(TO_CHAR(ln.disbursedon_date, 'Month')), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ln.disbursedon_date) ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ln.disbursedon_date) ASC ) lt ) loantrend, (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(STRING_AGG(CONCAT(CAST(o.id AS VARCHAR), ':', o.name), ',' ORDER BY o.hierarchy), '') AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS officeData FROM m_office o WHERE o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ino.hierarchy FROM m_office ino WHERE ino.id = ${officeId}), '%') ) offices, (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(STRING_AGG(CONCAT(CAST(lp.id AS VARCHAR), ':', lp.name), ','), '') AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS loanProductData FROM m_product_loan lp ) loanproducts, (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(STRING_AGG(CONCAT(CAST(o.id AS VARCHAR), ':', o.name, ':', CAST(COALESCE(cc.cnt, 0) AS VARCHAR)), ',' ORDER BY o.name), '') AS VARCHAR(4000)) AS clientByOfficeData FROM m_office o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.office_id, COUNT(c.id) AS cnt FROM m_client c WHERE c.status_enum = 300 GROUP BY c.office_id ) cc ON cc.office_id = o.id WHERE o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT((SELECT ino.hierarchy FROM m_office ino WHERE ino.id = ${officeId}), '%') ) clientbyoffice

column.name: description
column.value: Single consolidated dashboard report combining: client count, loan count, savings count, demand vs collection, disbursal vs awaiting, client trend by month, loan trend by month, office listing, loan products, and client count by office
